items.item_text: Master’s degree from an accredited college or university or equivalent experience and education.
Master’s degree in in Biomedical Engineering, Bioengineering, or Biomaterials.

Experience coordinating research grant programs, initiatives, or centers; ability to apply acquired job skills, policies, and procedures to resolve problems; and complete work assignments. Ability to function as a primary resource for an assigned area within a broader research grant program initiative.

Prior experience in a research administration or sponsored program’s role at an academic or research institution. Demonstrated proposal development, milestone/portfolio tracking, or program evaluation knowledge.

Academic background and experience in the selected area of research; strong oral and written communication skills; strong ability to think creatively and independently; strong interpersonal skills; ability to work collaboratively; proven program planning and project management.
Experience working across multiple stakeholder groups.

The Program Officer will serve in a lead role under limited supervision from the Primary Investigator, managing a large milestone-driven ARPA-H project. The role will manage and ensure the overall coordination of technical milestones, deliverables, risk registers, partner communications, reporting packages, meeting materials, action items, and cross-institution execution. The officer will work closely with the PI, technical leads, research administrators, contracts and grants staff, and sixxternal partners to ensure that the project remains aligned with ARPA-H milestones, budget expectations, transition goals, and reporting obligations. When effort allocation permits, the officer will also support related strategic research-development activities, including proposal planning, project dashboards, internal review timelines, and coordination of high-priority translational research initiatives in the laboratory.
45% - Program Research Project Management and Milestone Tracking

Advanced oral and written communication skills; advanced ability to analyze information, problems, and procedures to define needs and objectives; demonstrated ability to formulate solutions and support new program development; advanced program planning and project management skills.
